thread.title: Apple (AAPL) and Facebook (FB) Are Reporting Earnings: Look For These Keys - TheStreet

author: Jacob Sonenshine
title: Apple (AAPL) and Facebook (FB) Are Reporting Earnings: Look For These Keys - TheStreet
text:
The U.S. stock market was mixed Tuesday.
With macro economic indicators -- U.S. GDP, U.S. employment and Chinese GDP -- wavering in both directions in the past few months, stocks have continued to be volatile. Trade issues also won't have much real direction until the trade truce ends and U.S.-Sino relations become clearer.
So let's talk company specifics.
Apple Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) reported earnings after the closing bell Tuesday. TheStreet's Katherine Ross will be tweeting out news on the earnings call from late afternoon to early evening. Apple was RealMoney 's stock of the day Tuesday. TheStreet will be hosting a live blog covering Apple's earnings after the close. Please check our home page for more details.
Apple is back to $154 a share, just under where it was before it warned, in early January, of a lower sales number for this quarter.
Facebook Facebook Inc. ( FB ) reports earnings after the closing bell Wednesday. It's more than 30% down from its all-time high, technically still leaving it in bear market territory. Meanwhile, analysts have been saying Instagram user growth and monetization have been underappreciated , as investors have jeered the decelerating core Facebook platform revenue. Many analysts have bullish price targets on the stock of above $190 a share.
